name: M3 derivative regex candidate Java/JNI
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'm3/ports/precompute/**'
      - '.github/workflows/m3-derivative-regex-port.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  derivative-java-native:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '21'
      - name: Build Java derivative and differential tests
        run: |
          mvn -B -ntp -f m3/ports/precompute/pom.xml -Dtest=M3RegexDerivativeTest,M3RegexDerivativeEffectsBridgeTest test
      - name: Build C11 and JNI parity
        run: |
          mvn -B -ntp -f m3/ports/precompute/pom.xml -Pnative -Dtest=M3RegexDerivativeTest,M3RegexDerivativeEffectsBridgeTest test
